speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with a chronic cough and recurrent bouts of bronchitis. To help me understand your condition better, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and do they worsen at any specific time of day or season?

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. The patient has been experiencing an aggressive cough producing copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum for about 11 years, with exacerbations similar to the current presentation today. Reports that the cough is worse in the morning and has had multiple evaluations in the past due to recurrent bouts of bronchitis requiring antibiotics treatment. The patient is a non-smoker.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

The history of an 11-year chronic cough with copious, thick, yellow-green sputum, morning worsening, and recurrent bronchitis requiring antibiotics is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis. Given the severity and duration of symptoms, I need to confirm the structural lung changes. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CTA or Chest_CT
